function recursiveDefault({a = (() => a)()}: {a?: number} = {}) {
  return a;
}
function inferredDefault({a = 1, b = (() => a)()} = {}) {
  return b;
}
function inferredNestedDefault({nested: [a = 3, b = (() => a)()] = []}: {nested?: [number?, number?]} = {}) {
  return b;
}
console.log(recursiveDefault(), inferredDefault(), inferredNestedDefault());
